title: Product noise stability
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $f\colon\Omega^n\to\mathbb{R}$. For $0\leq\rho\leq1$, the product noise stability of $f$ at parameter $\rho$ is the product-space inner product of $f$ with its image under the product noise operator at parameter $\rho$.
